title: Bind task tools and Dot effects to current execution authority
summary: Carry tier, tenant, owner, task and lease through dispatch, provider tools and persisted effects.
hint_triggers: A runtime must receive an immutable task binding and validate the current WorkItem claim at every tool call. Keep Dot payloads in tier and tenant partitions and require explicit ownership for personal effects; unknown legacy scope is held for reviewed migration. Treat approval pending as resumable state and require written deliverable readback plus canonical controller evidence before completion. Provider-native tools and inherited integrations must obey the same bounded capability contract as API function calls.
